notes.title: NEW PRICING
notes.notes:
Dear community,

As is our tradition, one year after the game's release, we're scheduling an increase to the base game's price.

Once the current sale ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/LovecraftianDays2025]Lovecraftian Days[/url]) ends, the new price will go into effect.

If you'd like—and are able—to support us at the new price, we'd greatly appreciate it. Otherwise, please consider wishlisting the game and keep an eye out for our frequent sales!

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Saturnalia making-of talk now available, plus LudoNarraCon participation!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We did a presentation at the recent Game Developers Conference covering the design (and planning) aspect of Saturnalia's development. You can watch it for free here:

[url=https://gdcvault.com/play/1034451/Independent-Games-Summit-Saturnalia]Saturnalia Postmortem Presentation[/url]

It was a difficult journey, as you'll learn, but we are very proud of the game and happy that me managed to share it with you.

We also wanted to share that we are currently on sale as part of the LudoNarraCon happening right now on Steam, check it out: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/ludonarracon There are panels, new demos, and lots of great narrative games on sale.

That's all for now, thank you as always for your support!

Everybody take care,

Pietro and the team at SR

notes.title: Saturnalia is now available in Simplified Chinese!
notes.notes:
[b]《Saturnalia》的简体中文版本现已上架！十分感谢Albert Chen担当译者。[/b]

Hello everyone!

We're happy to announce that [i]Saturnalia[/i] is now playable in an additional language – Simplified Chinese.

The translation has been executed with love and dedication to be as close as possible to the original material. The translator is Albert "Windyshine" Chen, who also translated our other games [i]Milky Way Prince – The Vampire Star[/i] and [i]Mediterranea Inferno, [/i]

Everybody take care,

Pietro and the team at SR

notes.title: Saturnalia Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Our single-player survival-horror adventure has officially landed on Steam, and we can finally invite you to delve into the mysterious traditions of the village of Gravoi. 

Check out the accolades and launch trailer below:

[previewyoutube=JnF48X7y8_s;full][/previewyoutube]

You play as four characters, embarking on a journey intertwined with the eerie heritage of the island of Sardinia. The village itself is an intricate, ever-changing labyrinth, providing an unguided experience where the death of the four protagonists reshapes the roads into new forms.

At launch and for the first week, Saturnalia will be available at a 25% discount, priced at just $14.99 / 14,99€ instead of $19.99 / 19,99€.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/916350/Saturnalia/

(Also available in bundle with the soundtrack! See main store page for more info)

We can't wait to hear what you think! Please join us here on the community discussions, or on [url= https://discord.gg/rsuwh9HbPJ]Discord[/url], but more than anything please remember to leave a review, as it really does help us immensely in spreading the word!

A bit thank you for your patience and support from the whole Santa Ragione team <3

notes.title: Saturnalia at Steam Scream: The Revenge!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

During [i]Steam Scream: The Revenge! [/i]you can play and give precious feedback on our 40 minutes demo, which includes all the new features developed for the Steam release: First Person Mode, Film Noir Mode, Photo Mode, and New Accessibility Features.

Check out the Store page to see a pre-recorded stream of the game including a 10-minute developer commentary, 40 minutes of extended gameplay showcasing the new features, and a 10-minute audio design commentary by Saturnalia's sound designer Michael Manning.

[b]Saturnalia will launch on Steam on November 8th![/b] Remember to add it to your wishlist to help us with visibility on the store.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/916350/Saturnalia/

Thank you for your support, we can't wait to hear what you think!

Pietro and the team at SR.

notes.title: Available on November 8th!
notes.notes:
Dear friends,

We hope you're doing well! We finally have a release date to share with you! Saturnalia, will be launching on Steam this November 8th!

This release will introduce a few extra features:
[list]
[*]First Person mode: Now you can fully immerse yourself in the game by playing in first person! And if you prefer, you can even set it up to automatically switch to first person when inside buildings.
[*]Photo mode: Capture your favorite moments and share them with friends using our in-game photo mode, complete with FOV, roll, and post-processing options.
[*]Film Noir mode: Looking for a unique twist? Try our Film Noir mode, which transforms the game into a black and white noir movie experience (instead of Giallo!).
[/list]
here's a release date trailer showing the new modes: [previewyoutube=wERsTcYBTqA;full]https://youtu.be/wERsTcYBTqA[/previewyoutube]

We also care about your comfort while playing, so we've added accessibility features to help with motion sickness. These include camera responsiveness options and the ability to turn off the rotoscoping effect, allowing characters to animate at a smooth 60 fps.

We are also supporting cloud saves and achievements, of course <3 

To make sure you don't miss out on the release, and to help us get noticed on Steam, you can wishlist Saturnalia here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/916350/Saturnalia/

We can't wait for you to play the game and tell us what you think! As always, thank you for your support, and see you on November 8th!

Pietro and the team at SR

PS Don't forget to check out the 40-minute demo!

PPS We are also working on a new Simplified Chinese translation, coming in early 2024. More details soon!

notes.title: Play Saturnalia's demo now!
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/916350/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1187220/

Hello everyone!

We are finally releasing a demo for Saturnalia, our survival horror adventure coming to Steam in 2023! 

On top of providing a good look at the game's world, mechanics, and characters, the 40-minute demo introduces several new features we've designed for this release:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44058391/fceda56ea5e66a10f928ebf9da7c07d39f9ac01b.png[/img]

The first addition is the [b]First Person Mode[/b]. You can also set it up to dynamically switch between third and first person when entering buildings and smaller spaces.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44058391/867d8b114ec9c30225d2635d04a0a8754832dac3.png[/img]

There is also a full-fledged[b] Photo Mode[/b] and the new [b]Film Noir Mode[/b]. This alternative rendering is an homage to the classic black and white thrillers of Italian cinema.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44058391/72f4aae82f9cdef2ee8bd9076c9950125717acf0.png[/img]

Saturnalia is coming later this year, remember to wishlist!

Thank you as always for your support,

Pietro and the team at SR

notes.title: Saturnalia is coming to Steam this year!
notes.notes:
Dear friends,

We hope you're doing well! We have some fantastic news to share with you that we think you'll be excited about. Our third-person survival horror adventure, Saturnalia, will be launching on Steam later this year!

We've been working hard to create an immersive and thrilling gaming experience for you, and we're proud to introduce a few new features for the Steam release:
[list]
[*]First Person mode: Now you can fully immerse yourself in the game by playing in first person! And if you prefer, you can even set it up to automatically switch to first person when inside buildings.
[*]Photo mode: Capture your favorite moments and share them with friends using our in-game photo mode, complete with FOV, roll, and post-processing options.
[*]Film Noir mode: Looking for a unique twist? Try our Film Noir mode, which transforms the game into a black and white noir movie experience (instead of Giallo!).
[/list]
We also care about your comfort while playing, so we've added accessibility features to help with motion sickness. These include camera responsiveness options and the ability to turn off the rotoscoping effect, allowing characters to animate at a smooth 60 fps.

To make sure you don't miss out on the action, you can wishlist Saturnalia on Steam starting today!

And to give you a sneak peek of what's in store, check out our trailer highlighting the new features: [previewyoutube=Wu-dLkGwZd4;full]https://youtu.be/Wu-dLkGwZd4[/previewyoutube]

We can't wait for you to join us on this thrilling adventure! As always, thank you for your support, and we'll keep you updated on the latest news about Saturnalia's release.

Happy gaming!
